description: React component for managing channel access rules in Mattermost, including editing rules, toggling auto-add, and handling save/cancel workflows with modals and validations.

classes.name: ChannelSettingsAccessRulesTab
classes.description: React functional component for managing channel access rules, including editing expressions, toggling auto-sync, and handling save/cancel workflows with modals and validations.

methods.name: loadAttributes
methods.description: Fetches user attribute fields for access control, handles permission errors.

methods.name: loadChannelPolicy
methods.description: Loads existing channel access policy and initializes state.

methods.name: handleExpressionChange
methods.description: Updates expression state when user edits access rules.

methods.name: handleParseError
methods.description: Handles parse errors from the table editor, sets form error message.

methods.name: isEmptyRulesState
methods.description: Determines if there are no channel rules or system policies.

methods.name: combineSystemAndChannelExpressions
methods.description: Combines system policies and channel expression into a single expression with AND logic.

methods.name: validateSelfExclusion
methods.description: Validates if current user satisfies the access rules via backend endpoint.

methods.name: isBecomingLessRestrictive
methods.description: Compares old and new expressions to determine if rules are less restrictive.

methods.name: calculateMembershipChanges
methods.description: Calculates users to add or remove based on expression matching.

methods.name: performSave
methods.description: Saves the current access rules, updates policies, and triggers sync jobs.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Main save handler that manages validation, warnings, and calls performSave.

methods.name: handleConfirmSave
methods.description: Confirms and executes save after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Handles save button click, prevents duplicates, and calls handleSave.

methods.name: handleActivityWarningContinue
methods.description: Proceeds with save after user acknowledges activity warning.
